metadata.title: Interference Construction of a Perfect Reflection Map from a Fermionic Inverse-Phase Core
metadata.description: This release publishes an additional constructive experiment in which the direct direction-reversal rule used in a previous AB/C complete elastic-reflection simulation is replaced by a local exchange-interference map controlled by the internal phase of a fermionic inverse-phase core. The release includes Japanese and English manuscripts, TeX/PDF builds, the executed numerical script, result JSON/CSV files, figures, and a reproducibility bundle.
metadata.notes: The direction reversal in the preceding finite-resolution AB/C collision model is not inserted as q -> -q in this release. It is generated from the readout of a local exchange-interference map, q_out = q_in * (T - R), where R and T are obtained from the final waveform.
